title: No API coverage for /api/feasts/ route
reasoning: The owned URL file exposes the feasts API route, but the included feast-specific test file covers admin icon rematch behavior rather than the /api/feasts/ endpoint. None of the provided linked tests exercise routing, status codes, query handling, or response serialization for GetFeastForDate, so a regression that breaks the endpoint could pass the current linked test set.
recommendation: Add focused API tests for GET /api/feasts/ that validate the expected date/church query behavior, response schema, empty result behavior, and any authentication or anonymous-access contract intended for the route.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover Bible/readings helpers, devotionals, fast views, email behavior, Armenian text scraping, and feast admin icon actions, but not the feasts API route declared in hub/urls.py.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a test module or add a case that seeds Church/Day/Feast records, calls self.client.get('/api/feasts/', expected query params), and asserts the response status and serialized feast payload for both matching and missing dates.
minimumFixScope: Tests only, unless writing the test reveals an endpoint behavior bug.
